description: Initial structured handwriting capture template for consent-based glyph extraction.

provenance_notice.title: Consent-Based Handwriting Capture
provenance_notice.body: Use only your own handwriting or handwriting from someone who has explicitly consented. Generated outputs should include provenance.

notes: V1 uses a structured grid to make glyph extraction tractable.
Each character should be written inside its assigned cell.
Multiple variants per character allow the renderer to avoid repeating the exact same glyph every time.
This metadata file is intended to support both template generation and future grid-based glyph extraction.
